meaning: Generate a deterministic SVG definition card and versioned JSON metadata from the exact version commitment and user-approved display fields. The default card shows only the version commitment. Never read or publish private definition content automatically. Store the exact bytes and their digests; content changes create a new representation. Keep a content-addressed local review/export copy. Before minting, require an explicitly configured content-addressed retrieval location and a successful exact-byte readback of media and metadata. Promise verifiable bytes at confirmation, not permanent availability; show that limit to the user. Provider choice and deployment remain separate implementation work.
source_or_proposal: New local proposal; not a recovered source declaration.
